Players Committee card image of [[Theron Nett (V) (Remastered)|Theron Nett (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. While at a battleground system, opponent's starships may not 'cloak.' May lose 1 Force (free if piloting Red 10) to cancel a just-drawn weapon destiny targeting a starship he is piloting.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/theronnett.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 e8445f0] (1 June 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
